verdict.rationale: Square documents a dedicated 'Test in Sandbox' developer tool and Terminal/Mobile Payments SDK docs that imply in-person testing support, but the evidence pack gives only a title with no detail on simulated readers, test card numbers, or end-to-end in-person flow testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of simulated card reader behavior, list of sandbox test card numbers for in-person/Terminal API, and independent confirmation that sandbox testing covers the full in-person checkout flow before going live.
